descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S10 Existing spec: Today's Visits and All Residents page correctly, and an un-marked resident leaves only today

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 1; TFA-92587 How it works 1)
  • U4 Search over All Residents can add any resident to today. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 4; TFA-92587 How it works 4)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Residents created through the API, In Today, read in pages of 2 (including empty pages)

When Page through both views with search; un-mark one resident (update inTodaysSession false); remove another

Then The 'all' view lists every resident and the 'today' view only those In Today, page by page, with no other physician's residents. After un-marking, the resident leaves the today view and the today count drops by one, but they stay in the all view. Only the removal lowers the total

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in api/patient-list.spec.ts (ids per view, counts.today, isolation from another account)

Where it ran: datasets (seeded data sets, list checks) on dev; test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane datasets (datasets/results.json, screenshots not attached).
